title: Major Dimension Dream Date Essential Artistry Edit Eyeshadow Palette
descriptionHtml:
✓ Shimmer Finish✓ Long-wearing
What it is: A matte and shimmer eyeshadow palette with micro-fine glitter for buildable, light-catching sparkle.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Hyaluronic Acid and Squalane: Give the powder a soft texture and smooth glide.
- Treated Pigments: Provide true color payoff, superior blendability, and color that lasts.

What Else You Need to Know: Take your look from subtle to statement. The mattes provide rich color payoff with a velvet finish. The shimmers have a finger-friendly formula that presses easily onto lids, delivering a delicate wash in one light layer and more intense shimmer as you build.

This Palette Contains:
- 6 x 0.6 oz/ 1.8 g eyeshadows
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-Apply the mattes with our Dual-Ended Eyeshadow Brush (sold separately) and the shimmers with your fingertip.

-Layer, blend, and build dimension until you achieve your desired look.

Ingredients+
-Hyaluronic Acid and Squalane: Give the powder a soft texture and smooth glide.
-Treated Pigments: Provide true color payoff, superior blendability, and color that lasts.

Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Polymethylsilsesquioxane, Dimethicone, Isostearyl Neopentanoate, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Butyl Acrylate/Hydroxypropyldimethicone Acrylate Copolymer, Mica, Synthetic Wax, Diisostearyl Malate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Magnesium Myristate, Caprylyl Glycol, Silica, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Trimyristin, Behenyl Methacrylate/t-Butyl Methacrylate Copolymer, Isododecane, Hydrogenated Phosphatidylcholine. May Contain (+/-)/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Tin Oxide.

Intuition:
Ingredients: Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Mica, Zinc Stearate, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Calcium Silicate, Polymethyl Methacrylate, Polyglyceryl-2 Dipolyhydroxystearate, Octyldodecanol, Phenoxyethanol, Polyethylene, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Undecane, Glyceryl Triacetyl Ricinoleate, Trimyristin, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Tridecane, Hydrogenated Phosphatidylcholine, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Potassium Sorbate, Polyurethane-79.
